name: cx-sequence~p1
task: First find the key and then pick it up. After that, open the locked door, enter the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clauses `Existence(key_found)` and `Existence(has_matching_key)` are redundant because the hard `Precedence` rules together with the hard `Existence(has_matching_key)` already force both `key_found` and `has_matching_key` to occur. Remove these two clauses and keep the rest.

texts: Eventually the agent picks up the target ball.
The agent picks up the matching key only after finding the key.
The agent opens the target door only after picking up the matching key.
The agent enters the target room only after opening the target door.
The agent picks up the target ball only after entering the target room.
